Viral immune evasion mechanisms targeting innate immune pathwaysThe figure depicts representative strategies used by natural viruses to interfere with host innate immune defenses at multiple levels

Viral immune evasion mechanisms targeting innate immune pathwaysThe figure depicts representative strategies used by natural viruses to interfere with host innate immune defenses at multiple levels. Shown are viral proteins that inhibit cytosolic RNA sensing by RIG-I, suppress activation or stability of interferon regulatory factors, and block downstream interferon signaling through the JAK-STAT pathway. Viral modulation of the ISR is illustrated through inhibition of PKR activation and eIF2α phosphorylation, thereby limiting stress-induced translational arrest. The figure also depicts viral interference with humoral innate immunity, including inhibition of complement activation and membrane attack complex formation. Together, these panels summarize distinct viral mechanisms that antagonize cellular, stress-induced, and extracellular innate immune responses
